nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes:
What: Starts the read helper when someone posts a JSON body asking for a sheet range.
In: A POST to the webhook path instabay-util-read carrying a JSON body with a range field.
Out: One item whose body holds the posted JSON, so the next node reads body.range.
Why: responseMode is lastNode, so the HTTP reply is whatever the last node returns, no Respond node.

nodes.name: Read Range
nodes.notes:
What: Reads any A1 range from the hardcoded sheet file YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID.
In: The body.range as an A1 string, sent as a GET to the Sheets values path with OAuth2 auth.
Out: The raw Google reply with the resolved range, majorDimension, and a values array of rows if any.
Why: The range goes through encodeURIComponent, so a tab name with spaces still builds a valid URL.
